# Icons

118 icons from Lucide built in, ready to copy, and how to use any other.

Use one by its name: `<svg class="tray-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#tray-i-truck"/></svg>`. The script adds the sprite. `tray-icon--sm` is 16px, `tray-icon--lg` 28px, `tray-icon--flip` mirrors an icon in right-to-left pages.
